description: We are space enthusiasts passionate about all things related to space. Our goal is to create a program that helps young children develop an interest in Space Biology and understand what it takes to live and work in space. We are looking for someone to create informational videos and would greatly appreciate you joining our team to develop engaging visual content.
summary: This project explores how Earth’s food security research can support Mars exploration by identifying Earth locations that resemble Martian environments, particularly arid and saline areas. The focus is on cultivating salt-tolerant and drought-resistant plants to enhance food security and facilitate potential terraforming on Mars. This investigation aims to bridge the gap between terrestrial agricultural practices and the challenges of sustaining life on Mars.
details:
We aimed to explore how research on Earth's food security can inform future space exploration. This is a beginner project, and we are proposing an approach to identify locations on Earth that closely simulate the Martian environment. Because saline water covers nearly two-thirds of Earth's surface and deserts and arid areas make up about two-thirds of the landmass, our project will improve food security by identifying possible places on Earth where plants that can thrive in arid regions and selecting species that are salt-tolerant and drought-resistant can be grown. This data could support the terraforming of Mars for future human settlement.

The project has identified candidate locations on Earth and potential test sites on Mars, along with their pros and cons, presented in a simple comparison table. We used a scoring criterion for this comparison. While this project could be expanded with rigorous data analysis using machine learning and specific algorithms, we are not pursuing that due to time and resource constraints.
